newsitem.title: USA: U.S. March S&P 500 ends near record high.
newsitem.headline: U.S. March S&P 500 ends near record high.

text.p: Feb 18 - U.S. March S&P 500 futures ended just off from the record high set late at 819.50. One trader said volume was "not spectacular" on the run-up, but better than the lethargic morning. Traders said light buying amid quiet volume after T-bond futures closed had triggered technical strength. Resistance seen at 820.00 and 821.50, traders said.
